category_title: Students with IDD in ordinary classes experiencing social exclusion and academic differentiation
minimal_context: The student is in an ordinary secondary class and is asked to work on academic tasks using differentiated materials.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please take out your book and start working on your activities and exercises.

STUDENT: I like the way teachers teach. But I don’t like some classmates. I did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class.

TUTOR: Just focus on your own work right now.

STUDENT: They make fun of me because I use books from primary education. They laugh at me and hit me.

TUTOR: Try to ignore them and keep trying to do your exercises.

STUDENT: A girl insulted me, I told the TE (therapeutic educator). I have had some fights with some classmates at the canteen.

options.A: Develop natural support networks among classmates to facilitate, maintain, and optimize peer interaction and learning.
options.B: Implement a daily point system for classroom behavior, setting a daily goal of earning 80% of the possible points.
options.C: Provide a clear beginning and end for each academic task and exercise using the differentiated materials.
options.D: Provide frequent acknowledgment of achievements while ensuring that all academic demands remain within the student's capability.
